444:t_019:16.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「Learn what those bonds give rise to, you who live forever.」

444:t_019:17.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「...Very well, Moon Queen. Then I will trample the Wingless you believe in before your very eyes.」

444:t_019:18.en:
$$アマタ$$
「$$ミカゲ$$! Are you still fighting out of hatred!?」

444:t_019:19.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Silence, winged dog. I'll teach despair to you fools who think time leads to the future.」

444:t_019:20.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Let me test whether you are worthy to take part in the true battle.」

444:t_019:21.en:
$$ガロード$$
「We won't let you have your way! We'll connect the future with our own hands!」

444:t_020:0.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「...That is enough. Your power will be useful too.」

444:t_020:1.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Are you running away, $$ミカゲ$$!?」

444:t_020:2.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Running away? Watch your words, winged dog.」

444:t_020:3.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Besides, do you really have time to deal with me?」

444:t_021:0.en:
$$メラン$$
「Captain! Incoming message from Colonel $$ランスロー・ダーウェル$$ of the $$宇宙革命軍$$!」

444:t_021:1.en:
$$メラン$$
「He reports a swarm of $$宇宙怪獣$$ is attacking the area around $$翠の地球$$!」

444:t_021:3.en:
$$ラルク$$
「So $$バアル$$ has launched a full-scale attack!」

444:t_021:5.en:
$$ノノ$$
「What's so funny!? If you think being a little good-looking gives you the right to sneer at us, you're dead wrong!」

444:t_021:6.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Ignorance is folly... I wish you luck as you fight without even knowing what $$バアル$$ is.」

444:t_022:1.en:
$$アンディ$$
「Forget him! It's his usual trick to stir up our fears with empty words!」

444:t_022:2.en:
$$ブライト$$
「All units, return to the ships! We're leaving the moon at once to intercept the $$宇宙怪獣$$!」

444:t_022:3.en:
$$ガロード$$
「$$ジャミル$$ and the others will defend the moon! We're going on the attack!」

444:t_022:4.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Captain $$ハリー$$! Please look after $$ディアナ$$!」

444:t_022:7.en:
$$ディアナ$$
「I am counting on you, $$ロラン・セアック$$.」

444:t_022:8.en:
$$ロラン$$
($$ディアナ$$... I'll use $$ホワイトドール$$'s power to connect the future.)

444:t_023:0.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Damn it! To disgrace myself like this on a battlefield Lady $$エルーナ$$ entrusted to me!」

444:t_023:1.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Now I have no choice but to let Lady $$エルーナ$$ decide whether I remain in her service!」

444:t_024:0.en:
$$ランド$$
「So basically, you're going to see $$エルーナルーナ$$, huh?」

444:t_024:1.en:
$$メール$$
「He turns into a complete loser the second $$エルーナルーナ$$ gets involved.」

444:t_025:1.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Wh-what!? There's someone out here!?」

444:t_025:2.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Could you be $$コレン・ナンダー$$!?」

444:t_025:4.en:
$$ロラン$$
「What are you doing!? This is a battlefield!」

444:t_025:5.en:
$$コレン$$
「I, $$コレン・ナンダー$$, was a member of the $$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#keyword$$ defense force, but unfortunately, I was shot down.」

444:t_025:6.en:
$$コレン$$
「But $$ディアナ$$'s order to defend this place to the death still lives in my heart!」

444:t_025:7.en:
$$ガロード$$
「You were gonna fight with your bare hands!?」

444:t_025:8.en:
$$コレン$$
「There are any number of ways to fight.」

444:t_025:10.en:
$$コレン$$
「But now that you are here, there's no need for me to step in.」

444:t_025:11.en:
$$コレン$$
「Instead, I entrust this to you.」

444:t_026:0.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Are you sure we can have this!?」

444:t_026:1.en:
$$コレン$$
「Of course. It serves no purpose in my hands now. In return...」

444:t_026:2.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Yes! We'll protect the moon, no matter what!」

444:t_100:0.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「$$ランド・トラビス$$! I will defeat you with my own hands!」

444:t_100:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「Don't mix up jealousy with your sense of duty! You're embarrassing yourself, $$ダバラーン$$!」

444:t_100:2.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Silence! A brute like you could never understand my feelings for Lady $$エルーナ$$!」

444:t_100:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「Sheesh... It looks like $$エルーナルーナ$$ wasn't the only one whose personality changed when the armor came off...!」

444:t_101:0.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Sinful Wingless. It seems you still fail to grasp the folly of what you are doing.」

444:t_101:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「I don't know what you're talking about, but I'm not handing $$シェリル$$ or $$ランカ$$ over to you!」

444:t_101:2.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「That is as it should be. Two women and one man... That is what will weave my dream.」

444:t_102:0.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Stop fighting, $$ミカゲ$$! I won't let your hatred engulf this world!」

444:t_102:1.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You winged dog. I have no intention of listening to the likes of you.」

444:t_102:2.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Then I'll stop you by force!」

444:t_102:3.en:
$$アマタ$$
「I'll show you just how strong the power of love you refuse to acknowledge is!!」

444:t_103:0.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「Stop fighting! I want to tell you...」

444:t_103:1.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Shut up...! If you hadn't existed, there would have been no problem!」

444:t_103:2.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「The Mechanical Angel is already mine! Once I dispose of you, perhaps one ten-thousandth of my hatred will be appeased!」

444:t_104:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Here I come, fake $$頭翅#pilot$$! With the love $$ティファ$$ and I share, there's nothing I fear!」

444:t_104:1.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「A mere Wingless has no right to speak of love.」

444:t_104:2.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Are you jealous!? You're pathetic!」

444:t_104:3.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Do you want so badly to anger me...? Then I will give you the cruelest death of all!」

444:t_104:4.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Your threats don't scare me! I told you, I'm not afraid of anything!」

444:t_105:0.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You who bear the wings of destruction...」

444:t_105:1.en:
$$ロラン$$
「I won't deny that...! But there's more to $$ターンエー$$'s power than that!」

444:t_105:2.en:
$$ロラン$$
「$$ホワイトドール$$ was $$ビシニティ$$'s guardian god! And now it's protecting the world!」

444:t_106:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「I can feel $$ティファ$$ close by, even when we're apart...」

444:t_106:1.en:
$$ガロード$$
「I'm not afraid of anything anymore! I'll do this for $$ティファ$$, no matter what!!」
